notes: Dates above are from the 2026 flyer; check the page in March for 2027. Contact: 703-228-3329.
name: Arlingteens Leaders Summer Internship
what_you_do: Spend two weeks with Parks and Recreation staff. You try jobs like park ranger, nature guide, event planner, carpenter and preschool teacher.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 14 to 18 entering grades 10 to 12. Must be an Arlington resident.
pay_detail: Pay not stated. Lunch is provided on the first and last day.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications opened early March and closed May 10, 2026. 2027 dates not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Apply online when applications open in early March. To find the form, search for the name Arlingteens Leaders on the arlingtonva.us site. Look for the one that says teens.
